The nbfx Output API provides the pure-JavaFX output consoles: the FxOutput service and the FxConsole handles, shown by the Output view.
Build, run and test activities write into named consoles obtained from the FxOutput service. Each console accumulates text thread-safely and marshals it to the JavaFX Application Thread; the Output view shows the consoles as tabs. The default implementation is registered with @ServiceProvider; the view with @FxViewRegistration.
Build and Run commands stream the tool output into a console.
A user opens the Output view to read the streaming output.
The console registry and accumulation are unit-tested. The API is under development.
A JDK is required only to compile; JavaFX is provided by the runtime.
Only com.gluonhq.netbeans.nbfx.output is public.
FxOutput is resolved from the global Lookup.
FxOutputImpl is registered as the FxOutput service.
The Output view is registered under NbFx/Views.
None.
None.
Console appends are safe from any thread; they are marshalled to the JavaFX Application Thread. The Output view is built on the JavaFX Application Thread.
No console is created until something writes to it.
No code runs on exit.
No special requirements.
